stories.who: Schneider Electric, a big French maker of electrical equipment, and P T C, an American company whose software is used to design and build factory products
stories.what: Schneider has agreed to buy P T C for about twenty three billion dollars in cash; regulators still have to approve the deal
stories.why_for_people: Many factories make their products with P T C software, so a new owner matters to the companies that make everyday goods; the deal is not final until regulators agree
stories.script: In business. Schneider Electric is buying P T C, a maker of factory software. Many factories use that software. Regulators must still say yes.
stories.screen: a small glowing factory building with a single gear floating beside it, simple text-free symbol

stories.who: A hacking group that security researchers at Proofpoint link to the Chinese government
stories.what: Posed as an Anthropic employee in emails to A I policy experts, then sent them files with hidden malware to get into their cloud accounts
stories.why_for_people: The people who advise governments on A I rules are being spied on, and their online accounts are at risk; the China link is the researchers' judgement
stories.script: In security. Hackers posing as an-thropic staff tried to hack A I experts' accounts. Researchers link them to China. Those experts help shape A I rules.
stories.screen: a small glowing envelope with a fishing hook hanging above it, simple text-free symbol

stories.who: T S M C, the world's largest maker of chips for other companies, based in Taiwan
stories.what: Is reported to be planning another price rise of three to six percent on its most advanced chip wafers for early next year, because demand is bigger than supply; T S M C has not confirmed it
stories.why_for_people: Higher chip prices feed into the cost of A I products and phones, so people may pay more for them; this is an unconfirmed report
stories.script: From Taiwan. The biggest chip maker T S M C is reportedly planning to raise its prices next year. That would make A I products, chips and services more expensive.
stories.screen: a small glowing computer chip with a plain upward arrow beside it, simple text-free symbol

stories.who: Germany, whose leader Friedrich Merz announced it in Kyiv, and Quantum Systems, a German drone start-up that will build the drones in Ukraine
stories.what: Germany will pay for tens of thousands of small drones, built in Ukraine, that hunt and shoot down enemy drones; the exact number and dates are not given
stories.why_for_people: People in Ukrainian cities get more protection from Russian drone attacks this winter
stories.script: In robotics. Germany will buy Ukraine tens of thousands of drones that hunt enemy drones. Its cities get more protection from Russian attacks.
stories.screen: a small glowing four-rotor drone with a simple shield shape beneath it, text-free symbol

stories.who: Reflection, an American A I start-up backed by the chip maker Nvidia
stories.what: Is reported to be about to release an A I model that anyone can download and run on their own computers; it is said to trail the best American systems but match the best Chinese free models
stories.why_for_people: Companies that want a cheap A I they run themselves could get an American choice instead of a Chinese one; nothing is released yet
stories.script: In new models. Start-up Reflection may soon release an A I that anyone can run. Firms would get an American choice instead of China's free models.
stories.screen: a small glowing open box with a simple brain shape rising out of it, text-free symbol

stories.who: Researchers at Stanford University in California
stories.what: Set thousands of A I helpers to read records of old drug trials; the helpers found that drugs aimed at genes active in only a few body cells did better in trials
stories.why_for_people: It may help drug makers pick safer drugs before they test them on people, but it is a pattern in old records and no lab has tested it
stories.script: In health. Stanford researchers had thousands of A I helpers read old drug trials. They found a pattern that may help pick safer drugs. No lab has tested it.
stories.screen: a small glowing pill capsule under a simple magnifying glass, text-free symbol

stories.who: McDonald's, the fast food chain, and the owners of its American restaurants
stories.what: Reporters found that McDonald's uses A I to suggest a price for each item at each restaurant; the chain says owners may choose, some owners say they feel pushed to follow
stories.why_for_people: Diners may pay more for the same burger than at a store nearby
stories.script: In daily life. McDonald's reportedly sets each store's prices with A I. The chain says owners may choose; some feel pushed. Diners may pay more than at the next store.
stories.screen: a small glowing hamburger with a blank price tag hanging from it, simple text-free and number-free symbol

fun.who: Munchy's Pizza, a family pizza shop in Florida
fun.what: Promised online never to use A I, and tens of thousands of people saw the posts
fun.why_for_people: For small shops and their customers, saying no to A I can itself be a selling point
fun.script: And something lighter. A Florida pizza shop promised never to use A I. Tens of thousands watched online. Saying no to A I can sell.
fun.screen: a small glowing pizza slice with a simple heart floating above it, text-free symbol

teaser.who: I B M, the American computer company; and Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine, as told by one military analyst
teaser.what: I B M says its quantum computer did one test in seconds that a supercomputer would need many years for; twelve A I-controlled guns are reportedly set up in Kyiv to shoot down drones
teaser.why_for_people: A sign of how fast new computers may get, on one test only; and more protection for people in Kyiv, with no official confirmation
teaser.script: Also in the full report. I B M says a quantum chip beat a supercomputer in one test. And A I guns reportedly guard Kyiv from drones.
teaser.screen: a small glowing stack of papers with a bookmark ribbon on top, simple text-free symbol

bp.who: A I company shares and the American bond market
bp.what: Hope in A I is holding technology shares up while the cost of borrowing in America is at its highest in about twenty four years
bp.why_for_people: If borrowing costs stay this high, loans cost more and the A I share rally could fade, which touches anyone with savings in these shares
bp.script: And for the bigger picture: hope in A I keeps technology shares up. Yet borrowing costs are the highest in twenty four years. Watch those costs; the A I rally depends on them.
bp.screen: a small glowing stack of coins with a simple rising zigzag line above it, text-free and number-free symbol
